title: Farmhand executor intent v1

task.description: field_work: GIANTS' field-work helper works an owned field with the hitched implement that does the operation; complete only on the field's measured state; target is player_at_acceptance. deliver_tractor_and_forage_wagon: select, hitch and deliver an available pair. move_pair: move the hitched tractor and forage wagon nearest the requester. hitch_pair: select and hitch an available pair where the wagon stands, no delivery. detach_pair: unhitch the implement (of the named kind, else any) from the tractor it is hitched to nearest the requester, where it stands; target is player_at_acceptance. load_tractor: a free tractor (tractor_name) driven up onto a transport trailer's deck (implement_name), belted, ramps raised. unload_tractor: the belted tractor released and backed off the trailer, ramps raised. sell: the rig with the most cargo (tractor_name if said) delivers it to the best paid sell point; complete when the cargo went and the money came. store: the rig with the most cargo (tractor_name if said) delivers it to the farm's own storage (GIANTS' Deliver helper); complete when the cargo went. overload: a standing combine with grain emptied into a tractor's trailer under its pipe (GIANTS GOTO, pipe and discharge); complete when the grain moved. part: a trailer rig left beside a combine taken on past it. escort: a combine harvesting under GIANTS' helper (nearest the field, if given) unloaded on the move: a tractor's trailer held under its pipe at its speed until full or the harvest ends; complete when grain came into the trailer. mount_front: the named machine's front implement (a header) set down on a carrier that keeps a GIANTS lock position for it (its header trailer), the machine backed off; complete when GIANTS holds it there. teleport_rig: the named rig teleported to the field's edge (target field_entrance) on the player's explicit order; complete when observed there with its rig unchanged. unmount_front: that implement taken off its carrier onto the named machine (the carrier it tows parked with its unloading side open and unhitched first); complete when attached. land: the field's farmland parcel bought or sold (land_action) through GIANTS' own request at its price; complete when the owner changed and the money moved.

oneOf.description: move_pair only: back to where this companion took the implement from (the tractor's pose when it hitched it, or found it hitched for field work). No coordinates.

field.description: field_work: an owned field's GIANTS id, or the smallest owned field.

land_action.description: land: buy or sell the field's farmland parcel.

into_field.description: join_fields: the field the other is joined to.

want.description: buy: what to buy. kind: plow (a store plow our tractors can pull), truck, trailer or tractor (by the name the player gave), grain_trailer (a tractor-drawn tipper, GIANTS' TRAILERS category); size large: the widest that fits; engine: the motor configuration with these words in its name.

fill_type.description: grain_trailer: a fill type it must take (GIANTS' name, e.g. WHEAT).

min_capacity.description: grain_trailer: litres it must hold at least.

options.description: Other configuration choices by their words ('25m unrealistic', '25 mph').

cart_start.description: escort: the combine's tank share before the cart comes alongside (it shadows the combine until then).

remember_route.description: move_pair: the journey's observed line kept as a learned route.

tractor_name.description: fetch_pair, hitch_pair: the towing vehicle must have all these words in its name ('with the gmc').

cargo_name.description: move_pair: the rig whose trailer carries this belted vehicle (by its name or brand words).

implement_name.description: fetch_pair, hitch_pair: the implement must have all these words in its name ('the gooseneck').

crop.description: field_work (sow), hitch_pair: the crop to sow in the player's words; a seeder that can sow it, set to it.

hand_off.description: field_work: ends WORKER_STARTED once GIANTS' helper works the field; the pair stays reserved for it (the coordinator watches it end).

over_crop.description: field_work: the player said to work the field even over a standing crop ('... anyway').

area_m2.description: field_work: work only this much of the field (a bounded test area, m2); the whole field when absent.

operation.description: field_work: what to do to the field (companion/field.py OPERATIONS).

implement.description: The implement to hitch or unhitch (a GIANTS specialization kind; default forage_wagon to hitch, any to unhitch). Only for deliver_tractor_and_forage_wagon, hitch_pair, detach_pair, field_work, move_pair (to origin).

description: Move farm equipment to a destination. Every target is travel only; no target starts fieldwork. A place is the one owned placeable whose name contains its words. Arbitrary coordinates and vehicle IDs are unsupported.
